articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Poster Highlights Doctor Doom and 3 Latverian Witches
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has revealed a new Avengers: Doomsday poster, giving audiences a closer look not only at Doctor Doom but also at the three Latverian witches who will accompany him this December.
body: This latest look at the new Marvel Cinematic Universe movie was shared on social media as part of this weekend's San Diego Comic-Con Málaga in Spain. It was an event that saw stars like Anthony Mackie, Winston Duke, and David Harbor make an appearance, with this latest look coming arriving as a little more than a high-res look at Robert Downey Jr.'s take on a classic comic book villain.

Doctor Doom takes center stage in the new Avengers: Doomsday poster. He's looking as menacing as ever, striking a pose similar to the one we've seen before but with somewhat better lighting. The real highlight from the new poster, however, is the three Latverian witches standing behind him.

These three witches – and their hidden identities – have been the subject of much debate amongst MCU fans the last few months. These same mystery characters brought their purple, red, and green robes to San Diego Comic-Con in California this past July. The average onlooker might assume these characters will be little more than henchmen to be discarded in a massive CGI fight sequence, but some aren't so convinced.

articles.title: 10 Erotic Thrillers to Watch After Verity
articles.summary: Verity is out in theaters. Starring Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett, the film follows Lowen (Johnson), a struggling writer presented with a life-changing opportunity: ghostwriting the unfinished novel of Verity Crawford (Hathaway), one of the world's biggest authors.
body: The movie is a welcome addition to the erotic thriller canon. The genre has a prominent history in Hollywood, originating in classic film noirs, which were packed with hidden subtext, femme fatales, and detectives. The erotic thriller makes all of that subtext explicit, and it drew theatergoers in droves back in the '80s and '90s. Its heyday coincided with the rise of the VHS rental market, making these films huge hits at home too.

The genre has since spilled over into others, but it’s now experiencing a boom of sorts, aided in part by BookTok bestsellers like Verity and The Housemaid, which bring the genre’s trappings to a new generation.
If you’ve already seen Verity and hope to find movies that explore similar concerns, or are simply looking for a primer on the genre, this list is for you. Here are 10 erotic thrillers you can watch.

articles.title: Inde Navarrette Teases X-Men Role, Says She's 'Doing Everything Humanly Possible' to Do Rogue Justice
articles.summary: Inde Navarrette has opened up about playing Rogue in X-Men, saying she's "doing everything humanly possible" to make sure she does the character justice. The Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) X-Men reboot movie has a lot to live up to.
body: The actress, who was picked to play the power-siphoning superhero earlier this year, told the LA Times that she's not taking her role in the reboot lightly. In fact, she's doing anything but.

"I'm doing everything humanly possible because I love that character," Navarrette said. "I've studied that character. I want to do it justice for myself, for [director Jake Schrieier], for what they want to portray and also for what I as a fan want her to be like. I’m doing everything, exclamation point."

Having parts in shows like 13 Reasons Why and Superman & Lois means Navarrette has been on TV screens for years, but her role as Nikki in low-budget horror phenomenon Obsession took her fame to a new level. Through all of the Oscar buzz and turned-down parts, it was Schreier's X-Men she decided to sign on to for one of her first post-Obsession roles.

Playing Rogue in X-Men means stepping into the shoes of a character with decades of history. Aside from the Mississippi-born mutant's history in comics, she's also already appeared in numerous animated and live-action projects, with actress Anna Paquin portraying her in films like the 2000 X-Men movie and X2: X-Men United.
points: Inde Navarrette has opened up about playing Rogue in X-Men, saying she's "doing everything humanly possible" to make sure she does the character justice.

articles.title: Everything We Saw at RuneFest 2026, Including RuneScape 4 and RuneScape Reignited
articles.summary: RuneFest 2026 is over, and we’ve got a roundup of everything announced at Jagex’s big show celebrating its long-running fantasy MMORPG. RuneScape 4. This year saw a number of significant announcements, none bigger than confirmation that a fourth RuneScape MMO is in the works.
body: Jagex announced a new RuneScape animated adaptation, in partnership with YouTuber Charlie White, aka MoistCr1TiKaL, and production company Lyrical Media. No word on what this is exactly or when it will be released, but it’s happening!

We also got what Jagex called “the biggest roadmap in the game’s history.” 2027 content unfolds in three story arcs, all of which tie into long-running storylines. Hoard of Dragons (January) offers a sequel to the popular Dragon Slayer quest, City of Gnomes continues the gnome storyline, and Secrets of Karamja introduces a new endgame raid. Also coming is an Agility skill rework, new skilling and solo bosses, new area expansions, and a new Grandmaster Quest.

Old School RuneScape, meanwhile, got an updated roadmap. The Golden Gates to Menaphos are opening finally after 20 years, alongside a suite of fan-demanded content. The Fractured Archive, a new endgame raid, launches October 20. Hardcore Worlds launches November 4. And next year will also see the continuation of the Fairytale questline, Quest month, Dungeons of Gielinor, a Mining and Smithing rework, Chosen Commander, and the Tower of Xorphoros.

articles.title: 31 Years Ago, 'X-Files' Reached Its Zenith with a Near-Perfect 3-Part Thriller
articles.summary: Immediately upon entering World War II, America faced the problem of its messages being intercepted by Germany, Italy, and Japan. As such, the American military needed to develop a code that couldn’t easily be broken. Early in 1942, Los Angeles civil engineer Philip Johnston proposed a solution.
body: The strategy worked, and the code talkers, as they were called, were instrumental in many American victories, including the Battle of Iwo Jima. U.S. Major Howard Connor even said, “Were it not for the Navajos, the Marines would never have taken Iwo Jima.”

Despite their indispensable, patriotic effort during WWII, I did not learn of the code talkers from any history class. Instead, I learned about them on The X-Files, during a three-part story that represents a high point for the series’ mythology.

As with every other season of The X-Files, the show’s second season concluded with a cliffhanger that wouldn’t be resolved until the next season began. On May 19, 1995, the episode “Anasazi” concluded season 2. Then, season three kicked off with “The Blessing Way” and “Paper Clip,” the latter of which aired 31 years ago this week.

articles.summary: The Gears of War: E-Day developers at The Coalition say they are "proud to be one of Xbox's main titles" as Microsoft refocuses on exclusivity. Studio art director Aryan Hanbeck and creative director Matt Searcy opened up about The Coalition's place in the Xbox portfolio during an interview with…
body: "Well, we feel great because Gears has such a long, storied… It's part of Xbox's DNA. It's woven into it," he said. "At The Coalition, we feel pretty honored to have Gears and be the ones bringing that legacy forward. We know how much it means to people. We know how much it means to us."

Gears of War: E-Day is firmly a console exclusive, but there was a lot of confusion surrounding which platforms Gears of War: E-Day would be available on as recently as four months ago. The once-Xbox-exclusive franchise made its debut on PlayStation consoles when original remaster, Gears of War: Reloaded, released in August 2025. Many took its presence on PS5 as a sign not only that the series would continue to come to Sony's console but also that the days of exclusive titles may nearly be behind us – and for a while, that seemed to be the case.

articles.title: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy Is Still the Best Uncharted Game
articles.summary: If reports are to be believed, Naughty Dog is bringing back Uncharted. That's a tall order considering 2016's Uncharted 4: A Thief's End served as a pretty satisfying conclusion to Nathan Drake's story. How in the world, fans must be wondering, do you follow that up?
body: Uncharted: The Lost Legacy is a 2017 standalone spinoff developed by Naughty Dog in the immediate aftermath of Uncharted 4 's release. The game follows supporting character Chloe Frazer (Claudia Black) and former antagonist Nadine Ross (Laura Bailey) on a treasure-hunting adventure complete with witty banter and action set-pieces. Lost Legacy was co-directed by Escayg and Kurt Margenau, game director of Naughty Dog’s forthcoming Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet. The expansion's ability to preserve the series' formula without its iconic protagonist is impressive. What's more impressive, however, is how Lost Legacy transcends every other game in the series in the absence of Nathan Drake.

articles.title: Stephen King’s Bleakest Movie, With an Ending He Couldn’t Imagine, Is Free on Streaming
articles.summary: Stephen King movie adaptations have had a strange habit of becoming larger than the books that inspired them. The Shawshank Redemption and The Green Mile gave director Frank Darabont two of the most beloved King adaptations ever made, while films like The Shining, Misery, and Carrie have become…
body: Darabont's 2007 adaptation of King's 1980 novella appears at first like a conventional monster movie with a bit of Silent Hill baked in, but it devolves into a psychological windfall unlike many other King projects. The story kicks off after a violent storm damages the home of David Drayton (Thomas Jane), who decides to take his young son Billy (Nathan Gamble) and his neighbor (Andre Braugher) into town for supplies the next morning. Almost immediately after they step inside a local supermarket, already jam-packed with dozens of residents looking to stock up in the wake of the storm, an eerie mist rolls in and blankets the outside world in a dark white smog.

articles.title: One of the most popular Total War: Warhammer 3 mods was 'deliberately corrupted' by its creator to sabotage AI-made copies
articles.summary: Total War: Warhammer 3's Lords of the End Times expansion is huge, which is great for us but not so great for all the modders who need to update their work to be compatible with it.
body: It must be galling then to see someone vibe-coding your mod to be compatible with the update, then reuploading it as their own—just another of the AI-coded submods of your work plastered across the Steam Workshop, usually with some ugly AI-generated artwork as the cherry on top.

"Due to the growing number of unauthorized reuploads of SFO: Grimhammer III," Venris, the mod's creator, posted on Patreon, "and more importantly, the use of AI in the process, I have deliberately corrupted the mod to prevent it from functioning with such unauthorized uploads. If this situation continues to escalate, I will make SFO: Grimhammer III private.

"SFO: Grimhammer is the result of nearly ten years of passion and love for this community and the fantasy world. As such, I do not permit anyone to take my work without permission. Especially not for AI-related purposes."
Venris concluded with the call to "Support modders, not AI" and a note that "SFO mods were, are and always will be free for everyone as long as I am here. No paywall."

articles.title: Crimson Desert DLC delayed by 2 weeks, please join me in wishing the devs a fond 'take your time, please drink some water'
articles.summary: Crimson Desert dev Pearl Abyss has announced that its Charting the Unknown DLC will now release on October 29, two weeks on the dot after its original planned launch of October 15.
body: News writer Harvey Randall expressed a similar sentiment in August when Pearl Abyss announced it was slowing down the pace of free updates to Crimson Desert in order to focus on DLC development. Since launch, Crimson Desert has added new critters, new chests, a shotgun, new difficulty options, new mounts, boss rematches⁠—too much, really. I haven't played, but my friend keeps telling me about a "kung-fu button" that's supposedly in the game. Is he pulling my leg? Why would I not believe him at this point?

Charting the Unknown's first trailer contained a lot, but features producer Mollie Taylor fixated on the building construction options, something that reminds me of Skyrim's Hearthfire DLC. Mollie said it also showcased "running on water" and "grabbing onto a shark like some sort of aquatic Uber." What do you do in this game, again?

While the delay indicates this DLC is coming in hot, it hardly even feels like anything amid an industry dominated by increasingly lengthy development times. It's like Pearl Abyss is still blowing out the rest of the field in a 1600m race, but is now out of contention to break a world record. It's fine, man. You did enough.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director says he "did his best" to fight for a full disc release
articles.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi has responded to fans asking for a full disc version of the game, saying he "did [his] best" to push for physical media as the industry edges towards an all-digital future.
body: Speaking to Radio Times, as spotted by IGN, Hamaguchi explained his own attachment to physical media, from buying games as a child to wanting friends and colleagues in the industry to sign copies of their work.

"Personally, obviously, I bought lots of physical editions of games as a child. Sometimes I buy digital editions of games, but if I'm particularly attached to a title, I want to get the physical version," he said, adding that the topic has become "particularly sensitive" in recent months.

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will ship with a disc option when it launches in 2027, but PS5 and Xbox Series X players popping in a physical copy will still need to download a hefty chunk of the game to play it in full.
Hamaguchi acknowledged the disc included is a "key disc" containing only the game's opening, and that he understands why some fans have said "no disc, no purchase".

articles.title: Valorant player claims to have inherited hardware ban through secondhand CPU, Riot anticheat boss disputes parts of story
articles.summary: User After-Cartoonist-196 on the German-language PCBaumeister subreddit claims to have bought a CPU secondhand, but that it carried the previous owner's Valorant ban. Extreme surveillance measures have been adopted by esports devs in recent years to combat and punish endemic cheating in their…
body: After-Cartoonist-196's original post was reported on by PC World, and has independently made the rounds on social media as well. They say they bought the CPU on September 21, and that the original owner's ban was logged on August 12.

On Twitter, Koskinas said he was unable to find a support ticket matching After-Cartoonist-196's details, and that the story is "pretty unlikely." Koskinas pointed out that Riot hardware bans have a four month maximum duration, and that Riot support is required to provide the remaining duration of the ban when responding to a ticket.

That does leave much of the original story intact still: If the ban began on August 12, it will not hit the duration limit until mid-December. Koskinas firmly debunked one aspect of the story, though: He denied, in two separate posts, that a system's other hardware is blacklisted when detected alongside a banned component.

articles.title: RuneScape 4 announced at RuneFest, full MMO sequel started as expansion to survival game Dragonwilds
articles.summary: As reported by MMORPG.com, developer Jagex has announced a new MMO follow-up to RuneScape with the working title "RuneScape 4." The announcement came as part of Jagex's yearly RuneFest convention being held this weekend.
body: The announcement was accompanied by a brief teaser trailer showcasing the game's art style, which builds on the recently-released Dragonwilds survival game: It's like a hybrid of the latest Jagex MMO, Runescape 3, and the ascendant Old School RuneScape based on the series' 2000s heyday.

In the trailer, we see a real Dragon Quest-looking medieval town in a verdant valley under floating islands. An adventurer riding a dragon comes under attack by a three-headed dragon while a wizard watches from below. The trailer ends with the wizard welcoming a new adventurer to the city.

MMORPG.com has more details: RuneScape 4 apparently emerged out of a planned expansion for Dragonwilds. A Jagex developer said that playtesters kept asking for a more traditional, MMO take on the survival game's setting and aesthetic. Other than that, we know RuneScape 4 is being built on Unreal Engine (unclear if we're talking version 5 or the upcoming 6), and that the MMO's original, Dragonwilds expansion version was targeting release in 2027. Scaling up to being a full, new game has almost assuredly pushed that back.

articles.summary: Sony is reportedly in talks to acquire a big-screen adaptation of Electronic Arts' Battlefield, with Christopher McQuarrie attached to write, direct and produce, and Michael B. Jordan on board to produce.
body: As reported by Variety, Sony declined to comment on the negotiations, which reportedly followed a bidding war between multiple studios.

Jordan, fresh off his Best Actor Oscar win, could also end up starring in the film, though Variety notes that's dependent on several factors. Additional producers named include EA's Jesse Stern, Emerald Neon's Carter Swan, Vertigo's Roy Lee and Miri Yoon, and Outlier Society's Elizabeth Raposo.

Battlefield launched in 2002. The series' 18th mainline instalment, Battlefield 6, arrived last year and went on to become the bestselling first-person shooter of the year, and of the franchise's history, reportedly outselling Call of Duty ( which is getting its own film treatment, of course, with Peter Berg directing a Taylor Sheridan script for Paramount, dated for release on 30th June 2028).

Battlefield recently unveiled Rapid Royale, Redsec's version of Warzone's Resurgence. Resurgence takes place on dedicated maps that are far smaller than the main mode's large playground, and offers many ways to respawn after death. The pace is significantly faster with more frequent firefights as a result.

articles.title: Capcom plans to evolve RE Engine into an "AI-generation game engine"
articles.summary: Capcom wants to transform its in-house RE Engine into what it's calling an "AI-generation game engine".
body: As reported by gamebiz (via VGC ), programmer Satoshi Ishida outlined the plans at the "Capcom Open Conference RE:2026" event yesterday (2nd October), explaining that the changes were coming as part of an ongoing overhaul dubbed the REX Project.
RE Engine has been in development since 2014 and made its debut in Resident Evil 7 back in 2017. It's since been the engine behind the best part of 30 Capcom titles.

Ishida pointed to three challenges driving the REX Project – one, games have grown so large in scope and data volume that build and iteration times are slowing development down; two, RE Engine is now used by over 2,000 developers, including international staff and people coming from other engines, requiring better multilingual and accessibility support; and three, AI needs to be built into the development pipeline rather than bolted on.

That's why Capcom intends to bundle several new systems into the REX Project, including RE:Dox, which standardises data processing across formats, RE:UI, which speeds up development tools by separating appearance from state, and RE:Log, which swaps text-based logging for an ID-based system.
points: Capcom wants to transform its in-house RE Engine into what it's calling an "AI-generation game engine".

videos.summary: The 2026 World Series has now passed its halfway mark, with Round 3 taking place in Singapore.
body: In the previous Round in Tokyo, reigning champion José Serrano dominated the race right up until the final lap, only to drop to 5th place due to a costly penalty. This dramatic turn of events has significantly impacted the Points Ranking, in a race where the all the Spaniards were expected to hold the advantage.

videos.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered Review Update Video
videos.summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's Remastered update revisted by Travis Northup on Xbox Series X & PC, also available on PlayStation 5 & Nintendo Switch.
body: "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered’s greatest asset isn’t that it adds anything the original sorely lacked, but rather that it removes some of the biggest roadblocks to fun the 1.0 version was saddled with. Combat is more challenging but also easier to enjoy, movement is quicker and less irritating, and revised skill trees allow for more freedom. Even if it doesn’t manage to fix some of the technical issues (plus I’m sure there are some bugs waiting for me to encounter them that haven’t reared their ugly heads yet), it manages to make this classic RPG more enjoyable in 2026, and that’s worth yet another ride down its well-trodded roads."
